sources: Quaternius, Ultimate Animated Animal Pack: Deer.gltf (from https://pixeltriks.com). https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A deer: about 90 cm at the shoulder, a brown coat, a light belly, long legs, large ears.
A deer of the size of a white-tailed deer: 80 to 100 cm at the shoulder. The deer of Việt Nam (nai, Rusa unicolor) are larger: 1.2 to 1.4 m (the option size).
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
